case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Fox Logo Throughout the Clip
tests: Tests persistent corner-logo compositing, clean background removal, and preservation of the source video and audio.

faults.what: The supplied output is a standalone fox image, not the requested video with a small top-right logo.
The fox is surrounded by a blurred orange, brown, and black background with conspicuous dark halos, rather than a clean background removal suitable for a logo.

judge.summary: The output is a large fox image with a blurred background and dark halos, not the requested logo-overlay video.

must_haves.item: The video shows the same woman at the kitchen table, with the source framing and sequence preserved.
must_haves.why: No edited video is shown; the only output supplied is a fox image.

must_haves.item: The supplied orange-hoodie fox appears in the top-right corner from the first frame through the last frame.
must_haves.why: The visible output shows the fox large and centered, not placed in the top-right corner of the video.

must_haves.item: The fox has no visible white rectangular background and is not clipped at the frame edges.
must_haves.why: There is no visible white rectangle, and the complete fox fits inside the image, although an unwanted blurred background and dark halos remain.

must_haves.item: The logo remains small and does not obscure the woman's face.
must_haves.why: The fox occupies most of the output image rather than appearing as a small logo; no composition with the woman is shown.

must_haves.item: The original speech remains audible and synchronized throughout the 10-second clip.
must_haves.why: No playable output video or audio is supplied for assessment.
